[b]Operation Castlevania[/b]
The Council of 99 knew that the war had come to its crucial stages, while earlier stages were crucial, and Rosenmarkke had failed to reach its standard, with the majority of its navy lying on the bottom of the White Sea, its carriers practically out of commission in their berths and a successful blockade being established around islands that were crucial to defending the Rosenmarkket mainland as well as the White Sea itself.

When Julian had made his speech, demanding the demilitarisation of the islands, a great offense wouldve been made to the citizens of the islands, who through the centuries had been not only protected by Rosenmarkke as a member of Rosenmarkke, but also having acted as members of the defense itself, it was in its full nature a violation of the sovereignty of Rosenmarkke to demand such a thing. 

However, the courts would have to wait till after the war, for as HDF rained down its hell upon the islands, many of the leadership in Vespurias wrung their hands with great fervor at the seemingly impossible task which lay ahead of them in commanding the people, who had been cut off from external access save for allies.

In a series of orders given by Haakon Strømm, following the successful destruction of the remaining dense level security bunkers, which would effectively wipe out mainland central SCSID command capabilities. The entire command structure of Rosenmarkke would be sovietised with each island gaining its own command level, and various crucial sea-side regions being given a similar order to sovietise.  This doctrine taken from suggestions given by SummitONE would effectively announce to the armed forces that the threshold a traditional war had passed, and that the Rosenmarkket defense plans, built up since as early as the 1950s had become ineffective in the face of superior tech. 

Firstly, in order to preserve the air assets, of which three MiGs would be shot down and and F-35 would be forced to bail by its pilot at a total loss. The decentralised model of the force which had been implemented at the beginning of the war would begin turning to a lower sortie-rate with the highest maintenance planes being ordered to be grounded, while the older and cheaper models would move towards purely ambush roles, admitting that the airspace over the islands was to be still heavily contested with little room for total aerial dominance. 

Secondly the Rosenmarkket leadership realised that the cave design had failed, as a result, the individual island commanders would order cave operations to be quickly abandoned, with false firing signatures and heat signatures being given off in realistic response intervals in order to permit the movement of the artillery systems out of the caves, at the same time, due to the constant CCA surveillance, the Rosenmarkket forces would launch their own cheaply made kamikaze and shahid style drones to essentially flood the signature fields of the CCA surveillance with various heat and image disruptions, while strikes against the artillery leaving the caves were still able to be made, and a few indeed were successful, the independent command centres hoped that by flooding the field with hundreds of smaller targets, clarity would be defeated.

Furthermore, due to the thankless weather of that month, the Rosenmarkket isles were shrouded in dense fog on most mornings and across most nights when the humidity was high, as a result, the drones of the HDF would have a lower operability rate in the mornings, thereby permitting some motion out of the caves to be made. In order to block heat sensors, the island forces would utilise from emergency kits and from hunting and medical stores on the islands mylar layered thermal blankets to hide initial heat signals, while also utilising heavier woolen blankets as well. Furthermore, fires would be set along the transport areas and in various places to mimic heat signatures, along with tactical webbing and mass heat signature creation by flooding the signal with various large heat signatures.

The Rosenmarkket forces on the islands would therefore intentionally light dry fields and farmers fields aflame with incendiary bombs and grenades, turning large portions of the islands into one big heat signature. 

In the meantime as the anti-sub warfare intensified and three Akita class subs were sunk, the Rosenmarkket coast guard on the islands would deploy via the utilisation of fast speed-boats and a mix of military commandeered civilian helicopters as well as military helicoptors various sonobuoys of their own to detect the SSGNs and guide the subs from the islands. 

A key component to the warfare that the HDF had done was the utilisation of underwater vehicles, and underwater swarms, however, these generally required the vehicles to enter the water within the operational range of the Rosenmarkket land defense, thereby allowing Rosenmarkke to begin throwing drones at any HDF ship from various locations in-land and on the islands, the drones equipped with a 90 kg warhead would act in lieu of traditional aviation kamikaze tactics.

As the Wuloosyan attack began, with the targetting of the early warning radars, the clusters of SAM systems around the key structures would fire at these hypersonic vessels, intercepting several of them, although the largest of the structures would be certainly damaged. In the meantime assaults on stationary naval radars would be permitted to occur, under the orders to create a moving war as a result the islands and the mainland would then deploy smaller mobile naval radars immediately, disguised and hidden in various dense places including suburbs, forests, shrubbery, barns, etc. 

It had begun to be apparent that the HDF or Wuloosya intended to land on at least one or all the islands, it would be suicide to throw paratroopers into the heart of the islands due to the uncertainty of potential guerilla warfare, as a result, the various island commands would order all points of landing, including docks, oceanic transportation facilities, civilian and military, and even beach-heads to be destroyed through whatever means possible. Massive explosions would rock these key positions as mainland MRBMs and SRBMs fired upon them, and utilising the mandated Citizens first firefighting doctrine, any port blaze would be permitted to rage uncontrollably.

The commands would order strict civilian fuel rationing and designate special civilian refueling stations, advocating for citizens to carpool or avoid driving their cars at all. Following this arson would be committed against various gas nodes across the islands by the commands, including airfield refueling, port refueling, and other crucial refueling stations that the Wuloosyans could attempt to seize. 

In the meantime Ardavour Energy would siphon off parts of the oil lines to the islands giving them enough fuel rations in massive underground deep facilities in order to maintain the civilian energy sector.

In the meantime, further drone swarms would be deployed against any Wuloosyan plane that flew too low, with SAM and AA missiles firing upon them, and while their capabilities especially on the islands were lower than desired, the dense smoke caused by the burning of the fields and forests on the island would blind the pilots and sensors of the HDF and WDF. 

An order on each command would be given out for swarming operations to begin against the blockade, with fishing trawlers, yachts, and various other small ships and boats moving into the waters. With crude UUVs being launched from coves and other smaller rivers to begin the process of trawling, snagging, and even autodetonating the mines. Suicide boats would further be sent out to detonate mines.

In regards to the cyber-attack, the SCSID had done much work over the 3 decades that the internet had existed in ensuring the stability of the nations internet, as a result mass traffic filtering, CDNs, back up websites for government mainlines, and strict IP control would be unleashed or already present, with the emergency National Internet Security Comittee located for now in Vespurias with the Council of 99, utilising their connections to relay orders to on the ground data centers and the various internet providers.

Within the Rosenmarkket Stock Market, located in Vysjllá and Tharkønn the system had been closed since the start of the ceasefire as a precautionary measure.

As the cyberattack continued, the NISC would determine that most major stations of non-essential purpose would not be bothered to be dealt with, so if some child was watching a show in the morning and had their show interrupted by an anti-Rosenmarkket message, it mattered far less than if the news media or national emergency network was disrupted, as a result the news stations and key nodes of the NEN would signal switch across various signals, including piggybacking on  international signals. 

In response the NISC, aware of the successes of the cyber attack done by the SCSID in the early stages of the war, would order their teams to begin searching for exploits in the system, targeting information nodes, websites, and television programming to begin broadcasting meme content and spoof videos. In the meantime an attempted hack would be made on Wuloosyan siren systems across the country, with various Rosenmarkket childrens songs, patriotic songs, and even speeches by Strømm being played. Non-state actors within Rosenmarkke would launch seperate attacks on sound systems and PA speakers, playing meme sounds and songs.

Following this a salvo of drones would launch mass attacks on the blockade ships, dive bombing into funnels and other open spaces to cause internal destruction and combustion, in the meantime, a volley of 46 more MRBMs would be fired at key Wuloosyan mainland nodes including fuel depots, cargo dispersal facilities, docks, and ammunitions facilities, the move would be to frighten Wuloosyan citizens. 

The individual commands further prioritized citizen safety following two tragic strikes on coastal defenses along the two central islands would see the town of Harkkonen, a town of 10,050 severely by missile shrapnel and debris, killing 34 and injuring 250. Rations and water supplied would begin to be counted and issued to civilians across all islands from specially marked humanitarian stations. 

The government of Rosenmarkke would issue a statement declaring;

The blatant violation and disregard for the sovereignty of the islands, has forced its citizens into a position of direct conflict with the invaders, the Wuloosyan imperialists have put civilians in harms way with their attacks and have disrupted international markets in a way that will reverberate for months to years

[quote=new_westmore;61563251][b]Statement on Dalesburg International Airport Terrorist Attack[/b]
[i]The Democratic Republic of New Westmore has reason to believe that the incident which occurred in Dalesburg International Airport two days ago was a terrorist attack backed by the Sealiphate of Irocco.

Two days ago, an airliner took off from Dalesburg International Airport carrying a large quantity of contraband arms and drugs. This contraband was subsequently dropped over Dalesburg during its flight around the city. The motive as to why remains unclear, but Federal Police investigators have proposed that this was done as a tactic to intimidate or to incite a call to arms against authorities. After the airplane returned to the airport, the occupants on board attempted to escape authorities, and blew up their airplane on the runway as they fled to destroy the evidence. A shootout occurred after, resulting in the deaths of four of our officers and the arrests of two of the men on board. We are still searching for the third occupant of the aircraft. We suspect that the man on the run may have been the pilot in control. We are encouraging anyone with information about this man to come forward as soon as possible - the sooner we get him into custody, the safer our nation will be from this threat of terrorism.

We demand an explanation from the Sealiphate of Irocco. If no explanation is provided, or if our suspicions are vilified, we will push for sanctions and for further action to be taken against them, which may include a total embargo, removal from the Corridor Treaty or condemnation from the ICJ. We will also be completely terminating our bilateral relations with the Sealiphate until further notice - any Westmorians inside Irocco are encouraged to leave before the end of the month.

We strongly condemn any act of terrorism against our nation, and we will not take kindly to foreign actors maliciously interfering with the order of our society. Let it be known that we will not bow to terror regimes that seek to oppress us or disrupt our way of life.[/i]
